title: CIA and ODNI open-source intelligence system reportedly hit by cyber intrusion, officials say no classified information exposed
date_note: US media reports are dated 24 November by the Kyodo and CBS Nocut articles (published 25 November); the date of the intrusion is not stated.
place: Washington, DC, United States (Kyodo dateline; location of the system not stated)
summary: CBS Nocut News says the AP reported a cyberattack on a CIA unclassified system used to analyse publicly available material. Asharq Al-Awsat says the New York Times reported US officials said no classified information was exposed. Per Nocut, the ODNI said core functions and classified systems were not disrupted; the CIA did not immediately respond to Nocut. No perpetrator is identified.
plain: Outlets relaying US media say a CIA and ODNI open-source intelligence system was hit by a cyber intrusion. Officials reportedly say no classified information was exposed.
exec: A reported intrusion at a CIA unclassified system; per Nocut the ODNI says classified systems were unaffected, and the perpetrator is not identified.

validation.note: Three pages (CBS Nocut News relaying AP, Kyodo via Kanaloco relaying US media, Asharq Al-Awsat relaying the New York Times) are all relays; no English original, CIA or ODNI page was read. Merged from the duplicate record cia-odni-open-source-system-intrusion-2026-11 on review.

review.note: Compared title, summary, ODNI statement, no classified exposed, no perpetrator, dates against Nocut, Kanaloco, Asharq Al-Awsat, SN; single_source relays
